title: The Thomas Crown Affair
overview: A debonair, adventuresome man believes he has pulled off the perfect multi-million dollar heist, only to match wits with an insurance investigator who will do anything to get her man.

title: Gatto
overview: After years of maneuvering the canal-ridden, superstitious city of Venice, Italy, a scrappy black cat named Nero begins to question whether he’s lived the right lives. Indebted to Rocco, a ruthless local feline mob boss, Nero finds himself in a quandary and is forced to forge a truly unexpected friendship that may finally lead him to his purpose — unless Venice gets the better of him first.

title: Invertigo
overview: A group of reckless teens convince a young park worker to sneak them onto a rollercoaster before its debut opening. However a system failure traps them hundreds of feet in the air, forcing them to fight for survival as buried traumas and hidden tensions erupt into chaos.

title: The Exorcist: Martyrs
overview: 13 years after taking down a notorious satanic serial killer, a cop investigates a new series of murders connected to her past while her 12-year-old son becomes the target of a terrifying demonic force.

title: Elsinore
overview: The deeply emotional and inspirational true story of Ian Charleson, a gifted actor whose greatest challenge becomes his greatest triumph. Facing his own mortality with unflinching honesty, wit, and grace, Charleson delivers a courageous performance that becomes a source of healing and inspiration for those around him.

title: The Nightingale
overview: The lives of two French sisters are torn apart by the onset of World War II.

title: Sonic the Hedgehog 4
overview: Sonic the Hedgehog, joined by a new hero named Amy, faces a new technological nemesis known as Metal Sonic.

title: Sirius
overview: An Arctic action thriller inspired by the real-life Sirius Patrol, the Danish special forces unit charged with defending Greenland’s 8,700-mile frozen coastline.

title: The Third Parent
overview: A neighborhood Fourth of July celebration is interrupted by a ferociously bizarre anomaly who overpowers a family in order to teach them how to become better people and more compliant citizens.

title: Day Drinker
overview: A private-yacht bartender encounters a mysterious, onboard guest. They soon find themselves entangled with a criminal figure and connected in ways no one saw coming.

title: Godzilla x Kong: Supernova
overview: Features several new human characters alongside the beloved and iconic Titans Godzilla and Kong as they face off against a cataclysmic world-ending threat.
